name: Obtenebration (Dark Ages) — 3 Advanced — Walk the Abyss

system.description:
You can traverse that place where all is shadow, stepping into one shadow and emerging from another, or reach through a shadow to someone near another one. Expend two Mental Traits and step into a shadow large enough to hold you; you can then exit from any other shadow of appropriate size within 50 feet. If necessary, this action can count as a Fair Escape.

You can also reach through a shadow and grab someone to bring her through to your side, or attack her. Pulling someone through involves a Physical Challenge; other forms of attack also count as Physical Challenges, but the target gets a free retest since you cannot grapple and feel where your target is precisely.
